mentions.name: Smol
mentions.description: An open-source PostgreSQL index type for analytics workloads, designed as a read-only drop-in replacement for B-trees. Smol is multiplicatively faster than B-trees and radically smaller, and is limited to embedded and self-hosted PostgreSQL instances (not RDS/Aurora).
